user.description: User (name or UID) to run as after startup

sources.description: List of source addresses/hostnames with optional traffic classes. Each item has 'address' (string) and 'traffic_classes' (list of strings/numbers). Traffic classes may be hex (e.g., '00', 'be'), PHB name (e.g., 'BE', 'EF'), or decimal (will be rendered as-is if non-hex). See manpage for valid PHB names. Use lowercase hex to avoid ambiguity with PHB names (e.g., 'be' not 'BE').

iterations.description: Limit number of measurement iterations (0 = run continuously)

traceroute_interval.description: Traceroute interval in milliseconds (time between full destination rounds)

traceroute_duration.description: Traceroute duration (timeout per destination) in milliseconds

traceroute_rounds.description: Number of traceroute rounds to perform simultaneously

traceroute_final_maxttl.description: Final traceroute max TTL (when destination not reached)

traceroute_increment_maxttl.description: Increment of max TTL when destination not reached

traceroute_packet_size.description: Traceroute packet size in bytes (IP header + ICMP header + HiPerConTracer header + payload)

ping_expiration.description: Ping expiration (timeout per destination) in milliseconds

ping_packet_size.description: Ping packet size in bytes (IP header + ICMP header + HiPerConTracer header + payload)

results_transaction_length.description: Length of results file transaction in seconds (start new file after this many seconds)
